review_findings: The new owner is only wire validation and fixed dispatch; it does not replace session, Workflow, TaskRun, evidence, effect, completion, or merge authorities.
Closed operation-specific payloads prevent arbitrary reflection and stop Host wrappers from inventing defaults.
Explicit factory selection outside the request preserves project extensibility without allowing an untrusted message to choose executable code.
Natural language is data only on OPEN; exact candidate selection remains a Host/model decision validated by existing Starter selection logic.
The customer application remains independent because all additions stay in Harness control-plane paths.

skill_rule_mappings.assessment: ChatGPT, Codex, and other wrappers call the same root host CLI and transport dispatcher
the transport delegates to StarterHostOrchestrator and never writes a session or TaskRun directly
the fixed response policy denies write, completion, release, and merge authority
the transport and its state remain development control-plane dependencies only
